title: Sccs
summary: Assign observed intervals partitioned by drug exposure, annual-age bands and calendar years, with outcome counts and observed-day denominators. This simple risk definition is exposure time itself. Lagged, pre-exposure and post-exposure risk categories are not automatically added, and the recipe performs no conditional Poisson fitting.

required_tables.conditional: Tables, value/unit/time roles and vocabulary required by the supplied index and other event bindings.

required_roles.index: person, event key, start; interval end according to index policy

limitations: See documentation for fixed policies, windows, missingness, coverage, tie order, output schema and analysis limitations.
